name: Fácánkert (Hungary)
description: Light grey field with a green horizontal stripe along the top edge and a blue stripe along the bottom edge, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Fácánkert (a green shield with a white bend, a pheasant and ears of grain) above a scroll inscribed FÁCÁNKERT.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.
